abstract: Gastric teratoma is a very rare, usually benign, tumour of childhood. In industrialized countries, the diagnosis is facilitated by advanced technology when the infant is still in utero or soon after birth, and surgery is performed quite early in life, long before symptoms appear. This tumour was seen in our hospital in a 4-month-old boy. A mass had been noted at birth, but the infant remained symptomless. He was brought to hospital only on account of its rapid growth. The teratoma was successfully excised and the child was not seen again after discharge from hospital. We presume he remains well.
abstract_ja: 胃奇形腫は小児期のきわめてまれな、通常は良性の腫瘍である。本院で生後4か月の男児に認められた。出生時から腫瘤が認められたが、患児は無症状のままであった。急速な増大のため受診した。奇形腫は良好に切除され、退院後も患児は再診されなかった。現在も良好と推定している。工業国では、胎児期や出生直後に画像技術により診断が容易になり、症状が出現するずっと前に手術が行われる。
